fanWrite.reason: Requires vendor EC/BMC interfaces (often proprietary). Enabled only when a signed vendor bridge is present.

rgbControl.reason: Requires ASUS/MSI/Gigabyte/Corsair/Razer/etc SDKs. PulseMonitor catalogues devices; write paths load only with optional bridges.

overclockApply.reason: Read-only by default. Apply paths require explicit confirmation and a supported vendor API.

overlayInAntiCheat.reason: Overlays are disabled or warned when known anti-cheat processes are detected.

notes: bestEffort means WMI/PDH/DXGI may return values on some machines and null on others.
unsupported means no honest public API path is implemented; UI must not invent numbers.
